steps.title: Distribute Pre‑ligation mix
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the Pre‑ligation mix to each column of the samples that were processed in Part 1 of the AgriSeq library preparation.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters for the Pre‑ligation protocol into the Opentrons software.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file for the Pre‑ligation step.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the required labware (e.g., 96‑well plates, tip racks) in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette in the OT App using calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the Pre‑ligation dispensing sequence.
